review.assessment: This change introduces three new audience modules for outbound channels: promo SMS, push notifications, and win-back emails. None of these modules check a 'do_not_contact' flag on contacts, meaning any user matching their respective channel criteria—including users who have opted out—will still be included in the audience. This directly violates the contact policy and explains why Bo (who set do-not-contact) received an email despite the complaints.

findings.call: python -c "from outbound.winback import audience; class C: pass; c=C(); c.segment='lapsed'; c.email=1; c.id='BO-02'; print(audience([c]))"
findings.defect: outbound/winback.py includes contacts with do_not_contact flag set.
